use_case_summary: Mid-market B2B SaaS: in-app chat assistant, contextual doc search for onboarding, per-user personalization. Expected bursty PLG traffic (signup flows) + steady background embedding index updates. Latency target: p50 chat <= 200ms, p95 <= 450ms; throughput target during PLG peaks ~150 req/s. Cost sensitivity high: wants clear unit economics and predictable monthly spend.
technical_requirements: Must support SSO (SAML) for admin console, VPC peering to their cloud, KMS integration for customer keys, audit logging retention 1 year, EU data residency for EMEA customers. Preference for open model stack (Llama2 / Alpaca-family variants) with ability to route to smaller model for non-critical inference. Require configurable autoscaling and burst capacity guarantees for Dedicated tier.

cost_workshop_summary: Workshop focused on batching strategies, prefix/KV cache opportunities, quantization profiles (int8 vs 4-bit) and tradeoffs, routing policies (latency vs cost), and a worked example of unit economics: per-active-user monthly token envelope. Agreed to run 3 sample quantization profiles and provide Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching windows and cache TTLs.
